name: Older adult 1.04 m/s (subject 29, SPPB 10.0)
group: Real older adults: Caicedo et al. 2020 (markers, virtual implant)
cond: Real older adult: subject 29 (66.0 years, SPPB 10.0) walking at 1.04 m/s (Caicedo et al. 2020). Motion from Vicon markers (hip centres from pelvis width, knee and ankle centres from the measured widths). Implant signal computed 3 cm below the right knee centre, device frame. Strips under the activity band: what the on-device model says each second, as deployed ('chip now') and with V2 ('chip V2', trained without this person). Trunk and arms are drawn for orientation only.
